mapper.select: SELECT table_name FROM table_permissions WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_active = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO table_permissions (user_id, table_name, granted_by, is_active) VALUES (#{userId}, #{tableName}, #{grantedBy}, 1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE granted_by = VALUES(granted_by), is_active = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE table_permissions SET is_active = 0 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND table_name = #{tableName}
mapper.select: SELECT tp.id, tp.user_id, u.username, u.real_name, tp.table_name, tp.granted_by, tp.is_active, tp.created_at FROM table_permissions tp LEFT JOIN users u ON tp.user_id = u.id ORDER BY tp.created_at DESC
SELECT tp.table_name, COUNT(DISTINCT tp.user_id) as user_count, MAX(tp.created_at) as last_granted FROM table_permissions tp WHERE tp.is_active = 1 GROUP BY tp.table_name ORDER BY user_count DESC

SELECT tp.id, tp.user_id, u.username, u.real_name, u.email, u.role, tp.table_name, tp.granted_by, tp.is_active, tp.created_at FROM table_permissions tp LEFT JOIN users u ON tp.user_id = u.id ORDER BY tp.created_at DESC

SELECT tp.id, tp.user_id, u.username, u.real_name, u.email, u.role, tp.table_name, tp.granted_by, gb.username as granted_by_username, tp.granted_at, tp.is_active FROM table_permissions tp JOIN users u ON tp.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN users gb ON tp.granted_by = gb.id WHERE tp.table_name = #{tableName} AND tp.is_active = 1 ORDER BY tp.granted_at DESC

SELECT tp.table_name, COUNT(DISTINCT tp.user_id) as user_count, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT u.username ORDER BY u.username SEPARATOR ', ') as usernames FROM table_permissions tp JOIN users u ON tp.user_id = u.id WHERE tp.is_active = 1 GROUP BY tp.table_name ORDER BY tp.table_name
